work.title: The Tragedy of Romeo and Juliet
work.author: William Shakespeare

lines.text: If I may trust the flattering eye of sleep,
lines.plainText: If I may trust the flattering eye of sleep

lines.text: My dreams presage some joyful news at hand.
lines.plainText: My dreams presage some joyful news at hand

lines.text: My bosom's lord sits lightly in his throne;
lines.plainText: My bosom's lord sits lightly in his throne

lines.text: And all this day an unaccustom'd spirit
lines.plainText: And all this day an unaccustom'd spirit

lines.text: Lifts me above the ground with cheerful thoughts.
lines.plainText: Lifts me above the ground with cheerful thoughts

lines.text: I dreamt my lady came and found me dead,—
lines.plainText: I dreamt my lady came and found me dead

lines.text: Strange dream, that gives a dead man leave to think!—
lines.plainText: Strange dream that gives a dead man leave to think

lines.text: And breath'd such life with kisses in my lips,
lines.plainText: And breath'd such life with kisses in my lips

lines.text: That I reviv'd, and was an emperor.
lines.plainText: That I reviv'd and was an emperor

lines.text: Ah me, how sweet is love itself possess'd,
lines.plainText: Ah me how sweet is love itself possess'd

lines.text: When but love's shadows are so rich in joy.
lines.plainText: When but love's shadows are so rich in joy

lines.text: Then she is well, and nothing can be ill.
lines.plainText: Then she is well and nothing can be ill

lines.text: Her body sleeps in Capel's monument,
lines.plainText: Her body sleeps in Capel's monument

lines.text: And her immortal part with angels lives.
lines.plainText: And her immortal part with angels lives

lines.text: I saw her laid low in her kindred's vault,
lines.plainText: I saw her laid low in her kindred's vault

lines.text: And presently took post to tell it you.
lines.plainText: And presently took post to tell it you

lines.text: O pardon me for bringing these ill news,
lines.plainText: O pardon me for bringing these ill news

lines.text: Since you did leave it for my office, sir.
lines.plainText: Since you did leave it for my office sir

lines.text: Is it even so? Then I defy you, stars!
lines.plainText: Is it even so Then I defy you stars

lines.text: Thou know'st my lodging. Get me ink and paper,
lines.plainText: Thou know'st my lodging Get me ink and paper

lines.text: And hire post-horses. I will hence tonight.
lines.plainText: And hire posthorses I will hence tonight

lines.text: I do beseech you sir, have patience.
lines.plainText: I do beseech you sir have patience

lines.text: Your looks are pale and wild, and do import
lines.plainText: Your looks are pale and wild and do import

lines.text: Some misadventure.
lines.plainText: Some misadventure

lines.text: Tush, thou art deceiv'd.
lines.plainText: Tush thou art deceiv'd

lines.text: Leave me, and do the thing I bid thee do.
lines.plainText: Leave me and do the thing I bid thee do

lines.text: Hast thou no letters to me from the Friar?
lines.plainText: Hast thou no letters to me from the Friar

lines.text: No, my good lord.
lines.plainText: No my good lord

lines.text: No matter. Get thee gone,
lines.plainText: No matter Get thee gone

lines.text: And hire those horses. I'll be with thee straight.
lines.plainText: And hire those horses I'll be with thee straight

lines.text: Who calls so loud?
lines.plainText: Who calls so loud

lines.text: Come hither, man. I see that thou art poor.
lines.plainText: Come hither man I see that thou art poor

lines.text: Hold, there is forty ducats. Let me have
lines.plainText: Hold there is forty ducats Let me have

lines.text: A dram of poison, such soon-speeding gear
lines.plainText: A dram of poison such soonspeeding gear

lines.text: As will disperse itself through all the veins,
lines.plainText: As will disperse itself through all the veins

lines.text: That the life-weary taker may fall dead,
lines.plainText: That the lifeweary taker may fall dead

lines.text: And that the trunk may be discharg'd of breath
lines.plainText: And that the trunk may be discharg'd of breath

lines.text: As violently as hasty powder fir'd
lines.plainText: As violently as hasty powder fir'd

lines.text: Doth hurry from the fatal cannon's womb.
lines.plainText: Doth hurry from the fatal cannon's womb

lines.text: Such mortal drugs I have, but Mantua's law
lines.plainText: Such mortal drugs I have but Mantua's law

lines.text: Is death to any he that utters them.
lines.plainText: Is death to any he that utters them

lines.text: Art thou so bare and full of wretchedness,
lines.plainText: Art thou so bare and full of wretchedness

lines.text: And fear'st to die? Famine is in thy cheeks,
lines.plainText: And fear'st to die Famine is in thy cheeks

lines.text: Need and oppression starveth in thine eyes,
lines.plainText: Need and oppression starveth in thine eyes

lines.text: Contempt and beggary hangs upon thy back.
lines.plainText: Contempt and beggary hangs upon thy back

lines.text: The world is not thy friend, nor the world's law;
lines.plainText: The world is not thy friend nor the world's law

lines.text: The world affords no law to make thee rich;
lines.plainText: The world affords no law to make thee rich

lines.text: Then be not poor, but break it and take this.
lines.plainText: Then be not poor but break it and take this

lines.text: My poverty, but not my will consents.
lines.plainText: My poverty but not my will consents

lines.text: I pay thy poverty, and not thy will.
lines.plainText: I pay thy poverty and not thy will

lines.text: Put this in any liquid thing you will
lines.plainText: Put this in any liquid thing you will

lines.text: And drink it off; and, if you had the strength
lines.plainText: And drink it off and if you had the strength

lines.text: Of twenty men, it would despatch you straight.
lines.plainText: Of twenty men it would despatch you straight

lines.text: There is thy gold, worse poison to men's souls,
lines.plainText: There is thy gold worse poison to men's souls

lines.text: Doing more murder in this loathsome world
lines.plainText: Doing more murder in this loathsome world

lines.text: Than these poor compounds that thou mayst not sell.
lines.plainText: Than these poor compounds that thou mayst not sell

lines.text: I sell thee poison, thou hast sold me none.
lines.plainText: I sell thee poison thou hast sold me none

lines.text: Farewell, buy food, and get thyself in flesh.
lines.plainText: Farewell buy food and get thyself in flesh

lines.text: Come, cordial and not poison, go with me
lines.plainText: Come cordial and not poison go with me

lines.text: To Juliet's grave, for there must I use thee.
lines.plainText: To Juliet's grave for there must I use thee
